question: Distinct Consulting products purchased by enterprise tier customers.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Consulting' AND c.tier = 'enterprise'
pred:
SELECT DISTINCT
    oi.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    c.company,
    c.region,
    c.tier,
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    oi.quantity,
    oi.unit_price,
    oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS line_total
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'Consulting'
    AND c.tier = 'enterprise'
    AND o.status = 'completed'

question: Top 3 products by quantity bought by customers in Middle East.
gold: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE c.region = 'Middle East' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY units DESC, p.id LIMIT 3
pred:
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE region = 'Middle East')

question: Gross margin % for the Electronics category, completed orders only?
gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = 'Electronics'
pred:
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) * 100.0 / 
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.quantity * p.cost),
        2
    ) AS gross_margin_percent
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE p.category = 'Electronics'
    AND o.status = 'completed'
